We’re looking for obsessively curious people to join us. You'll join 300 B2B experts across strategy, data, creative, media, client services, Sales activation, and shared services. Different skills brought together in integrated teams, centred around our clients: the world’s most impactful tech companies. So, if you’re interested in what makes the world work, if you find solving complex problems fun, and you love making the answers as simple as possible, then we’d love to hear from you. **What we are looking for** The ideal candidate will have several years of Social Media experience and looking to take the next steps in their Digital career within the B2B space. They will be a great communicator and quick to adopt and learn new platforms and technologies. You will be responsible for the planning and delivery of organic and paid Social Media campaigns, drawing on a wide range of skills to delight our clients with social media that can drive audiences from awareness to conversion. As the go-to person for social media, you’ll be adept at engaging with online communities and influencers, managing content in line with communication objectives, and providing clients with in-depth reports and recommendations. You’ll also be comfortable with presenting and liaising with clients and colleagues of varying seniority, speaking confidently to showcase Social Media expertise, and adapting your communication style accordingly. **What you will do** Support new business activities: - Work with Media and client services teams on the creation of content that can be used to win new business. Client growth: - Support with the creation and selling of new Social Media propositions to client teams. Client management: - Take the client and internal briefs and produce Social Media plans that meet or exceed the objectives. - Engage in daily communication with clients and internal client service teams to ensure all briefs and deadlines are met effectively on time and to spec. - Participate in face-to-face and online meetings with new and existing clients and take the lead in presenting social media propositions. - Run Social Media workshops for clients, both face-to-face and online. Planning and strategy: - Responsible for the planning of organic and paid Social Media campaigns and projects across multiple platforms. Activation: - Set up, manage, and optimise different types of paid Social Media campaigns. - Approving creative. - Management and scheduling of content. Campaign management and delivery: - Manage costs incurred and revenue generated from Social Media platforms. - Suggest and implement new ideas, improvements and optimizations to existing campaigns and projects to improve performance. - Problem-solve, taking the lead in proposing solutions to any campaign issues that may arise, communicating your recommendations back to the internal team. Reporting: - Track, measure, analyse, and report on the performance of Social Media campaigns and projects regularly. - Share results, insights, and recommendations internally and with clients. Insights: - Help shape the Social Media strategy by staying on top of current trends, technology, and best practices to make recommendations to the wider team. Mentorship: - Monitor and guide more junior members of the team on Social Media activities, delegating tasks, reviewing, and feeding back on the work that they have delivered. **Success is measured by** - Team feedback - Client feedback - Completion of tasks to deadline - Programme performance **Requirements** **Who you are** - Very good communication and project management skills and ability to present with confidence. - Ability to plan and prioritise multiple workstreams and escalate where necessary. - Calm and consistent under pressure. - Results orientated, with a flair for using analytical skills to pull actionable insights from data. - Very experienced with using Social Media tools. - Good working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel. - Very strong understanding of and experience within the LinkedIn platform - Strong attention to detail and multitasking skills. - Able to write compelling short form copy. **What you will need** - Several years of experience managing Social Media campaigns and projects within the b2b space preferably agency side - Strong platform knowledge and experience using the LinkedIn platform in a professional capacity. - Experience in planning and implementation of organic and paid Social Media campaigns. - Experience in running LinkedIn paid campaigns which include planning, set up, optimisations, budget management, measurement and reporting against KPIs. - Strong knowledge of Excel. Good working knowledge of PowerPoint. - Experience and exposure within other areas of Paid Media is a bonus. - Knowledge of Reddit and its advertising offer is desirable. **Benefits** **What we offer in return** - **Medical, dental, and vision insurance:** Health is a priority worth investing in. We empower every employee to take charge of their health by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance so they can perform at their best ability. - **Pre-tax flexible spending account (FSA)**– healthcare, dependent care, and transit available: We are committed to saving you money as we provide high-quality healthcare that is as flexible and diverse as our team. - **4% 401(k) contribution with no vesting period**: We are invested in our employees' careers. Each individual has the opportunity to build a future for themselves through a 401(k), and we see that as a success for the company as well. - **Plentiful paid time off**: Each employee has the freedom to choose how long they want to be away from work. We recommend at least 20 days of PTO, so employees can fully rest and avoid burnout. - **Sick leave (15 days annually):** Illnesses are taken seriously at tmp. We provide 15 days of sick leave so employees can take their time to make a full recovery before returning to work. - **Holiday shutdown (December 26th - 29th)**: As the whole company shuts down for a few days, you can celebrate the holidays with loved ones. - **Parental leave:** - **Primary caregiver:** 12 weeks full pay and then 12 weeks 50% pay - **Secondary caregiver**: 12 weeks full pay **Access to Unmind:** Our well-being platform, including access to therapists and coaches **Employer-funded life, AD&D & disability insurance:** tmp offers all employees life and AD&D insurance and makes sure you and your loved ones are protected in times of need. **Company getaways:** Whether it is a local office holiday party or a full-blown international trip, we believe in bonding through quality time spent together as a team. **We are currently eligible to hire within these US states:** _CA, CO, IL, WA, and TX._ **A note on applying:** _Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Research shows some people hold back unless they meet 100% of the requirements. We do not want that to be you._ _At tmp, we hire for potential, mindset, and character as much as experience. If you are excited about the role but your background is not a perfect match, we would still love to hear from you. You might be exactly what we are looking for, either for this role or another._ _Diversity equals increased creativity, which equals better results for all. We’re committed to equality of opportunity and applications from all individuals are encouraged. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please don’t hesitate to let us know._ [Apply for this job](https://www.adzuna.com/details/5944842663/apply?aztt=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJ0dCI6Imdvb2dsZV9vcmdhbmljIiwibmMiOiJkMzI3ZjQzOCIsImV4cCI6MTc5NDAxNzA1OCwidHMiOm51bGwsImlhdCI6MTc5MzQxMjI1OCwiY2kiOiJ0RFVKWWNfVThSR1ZWb01waU82eG53In0.BKqxUXb__DUVI-klZvqavKfEpsTXj52w12pVHDl5JW8&v=EDBE2B249985BAF949E46500BA94608CB3CC7B35&se=) ## Stats for this job ### Salary comparison: | This job | | $67,500 | | National
